title: A visit to the fire station.
lines: Today Ilias's class is going on a trip.
They're going to the fire station!
Ilias is so excited that he hardly slept all night.
He has put on his red jumper.
The bus stops in front of a big building.
And in front of the doors stands a woman in a dark blue suit with yellow stripes.
They have ladders on them, and hoses, and blue lights.
all the children shout at the same time.
Fatima shows them the biggest engine.
This is the pump engine, she says.
It has a big tank of water inside.
That's as much as ten full bathtubs!
We spray the water onto the fire with this hose.
The ladder can go very high.
Right up to the roof of a block of flats.
That way we can rescue people who are high up in a building.
Can I get in the truck?
One by one the children may climb into the cab.
Ilias sits behind the big steering wheel.
Everyone laughs and covers their ears.
Then Fatima shows them her clothes.
A firefighter's suit protects us from the fire, she says.
We wear a helmet on our heads, gloves on our hands and big boots on our feet.
The jacket, the trousers, the boots, the helmet.
And then she puts on a mask too.
On her back there's a bottle of air.
That way she can breathe in the smoke.
Now she sounds a bit like a robot.
Like this I look a bit scary.
But if you ever see a firefighter in this suit, don't be afraid.
Never hide, but shout really loudly.
Then Fatima teaches them what to do if there's a fire.
She sings it like a song.
You are much more important than your cuddly toy.
You can buy a new cuddly toy.
Then she shows them something very funny.
A long, shiny pole that goes down through a hole in the ceiling.
When a call comes in, says Fatima, and we're upstairs, we slide down this pole.
A firefighter comes sliding down from upstairs.
Fatima and the other firefighters run to their engine.
The children watch with big eyes.
A little later the engine comes back.
A kitten that was stuck in a tree, laughs Fatima.
It's safely back with its owner now.
At the end the children may spray the hose.
At a little wooden practice house.
Ilias gets a red firefighter's cap and a sticker.
On the bus back he holds his cap tightly.
Miss, he says, when I grow up I'll be a firefighter.
Then I'll slide down the pole every day!
